Existing suite passing isn't the interesting part — race conditions are timing-dependent, so a suite that was green before the fix could easily still be green after it even if the lock did nothing, unless something in there is actually forcing concurrent access to the counter.

Did you add a test that spins up multiple workers/threads hitting the counter at the same time? And if so, does it fail reliably on the pre-fix code, or just pass now? If it's not flaky-on-purpose (i.e. it doesn't reproduce the race without the lock), it's not really verifying the fix — just decoration that happens to pass.
